rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=3, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-8 (one knob vs iter-7 best). NUMBERS soft_thresh(n_outer1): 0.0007->RMSE0.005542(iter-7 BEST), 0.0015->0.005580, 0.003->0.005646 (monotone: lighter better but tiny gains). RMSE still 6.3pct above the 0.005214 baseline; soft_thresh axis nearly exhausted (sub-1pct moves). FAILURE MODE: the last gap is set by NOISE the single residual add-back injects, which originates in the motion-compensated interpolation that densifies the residual sinogram to 2x angles before FBP. wu_motion_window is the L1 windowed-patch half-width for the per-detector shift match; base 2. ONE KNOB: wu_motion_window 2 -> 3 (wider matching patch, n_outer/thresh locked). HYPOTHESIS: if a wider L1 patch gives a more robust (less noisy) residual-shift estimate, the densified residual FBP is cleaner and the single add-back injects less streak-noise -> RMSE drops below 0.005214 and hr>0 clears baseline; if the wider patch over-smooths the residual motion and loses genuine mid-freq structure, RMSE rises -> window=2 confirmed and I try motion_range. Budget: ~seconds.
